result.title: Mining the Self-Rewriting System: A Vision for Data Mining on AI-Native Infrastructure
result.comment: Accepted to the Blue Sky Track of the IEEE International Conference on Data Mining (ICDM)
result.summary: Classical data mining treats data as generated outside the learner. Emerging AI-native infrastructure invalidates this assumption: as agents observe system state, act, update retrieval stores and models, and promote new artifacts into the serving path, their own decisions reshape the future logs, traces, corpora, and evaluation records used for later training and release. We call this new research object a self-rewriting system and the resulting system-induced distribution shift endogenous drift. Our central, falsifiable claim is that cross-surface causes are not identifiable in general from marginal per-surface monitoring: different coupled failures can produce the same individual signals while differing in their joint behavior, requiring joint analysis for reliable attribution. This agenda comprises four foundational research problems: fusing heterogeneous drift signals into calibrated gating and attribution (C1); mining agent traces whose activity alphabet evolves (C2); maintaining knowledge fabrics through online reindexing, faithfulness, and compression decisions (C3); and safely promoting concurrent learning streams through one shared evaluation gate (C4). These remain fragmented across concept drift, performative prediction, process mining, streaming retrieval-augmented generation, and MLOps, without a unified data-mining agenda. We outline public benchmarks and evaluation criteria, using AI-native telecom only as a motivating exemplar with analogues in finance, software CI/CD, and clinical decision support.

AI.brief_summary: 这是一篇 Blue Sky 立场的愿景论文：提出「自改写系统」与「内生漂移」概念，主张跨表面的联合分析才能可靠归因，并列出四个基础研究问题（漂移信号融合与校准门控、动作字母表演化的轨迹挖掘、在线重索引与压缩下的知识维护、共享评测门的并发学习流推广）及相应基准设想。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「跨表面联合归因 + 校准门控」与共享评测门设计，可能为 LVR 中贡献分配、继续/停止依据、检索证据库更新与在线筛选提供概念类比，属远领域启发，需人工核查是否可迁移。
